publication.title: Comptonatus chasei, a new iguanodontian dinosaur from the Lower Cretaceous Wessex Formation of the Isle of Wight, southern England

locality.name: PBDB collection 235576: from a plant debris bed on National Trust property to the west of the fault in Compton Bay, and close\r\n(c. 50 m) to where IWCMS 2013.175, a skeleton of Valdosaurus canaliculatus Galton, 1977 (Barrett, 2016) was excavated the previous year (locality 235262).

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 235576 to Barremian with numeric bounds 125.77–121.4 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 88932; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 1659876 records Comptonatus chasei in collection 235576, linked by PBDB to reference 88932.
PBDB stores the original/identified name as Comptonatus chasei n. gen. n. sp. and the accepted name as Comptonatus chasei.
